coverage.summary: Applies to all tenants in a building converted to condominium or cooperative ownership, or to fee simple ownership of units, whether or not they qualify for protected tenancy.
coverage.other_conditions: The building must be converted to condominium or cooperative ownership, or to fee simple ownership of units.

evidence.quoted_span: If a building is converted to a condominium or cooperative form of ownership, or to fee simple ownership of units
This prohibition applies to all tenants in the building
If a building is converted to a condominium or cooperative form of ownership, or to fee simple ownership of units

result.notes: The summary was narrowed to 'converted'. The guide's passage on this rent bar says 'If a building is converted'. 'Being converted' appears only in the protected-tenancy eligibility text, not in the rent-increase bar. The other_conditions entry was reworded to describe the building rather than an event. No unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or local-rule interaction is stated for this bar. The 'two or more dwelling units' language in Anti-Eviction cause (k) belongs to a different provision, so no unit threshold was added. All other fields remain null.
